dossier.psychProfile: Dr. Isolde Voss is 94% augmented with proprietary VitaSynth organs. Claims she hasn’t aged since 2051. Obsessed with legacy and perfecting the human vessel. Secretly maintains a private collection of pre-collapse human remains for 'research'. Sibling rivalry with Seraphine and Elara.
dossier.attackVectors: High-success social engineering lines: 1. Pose as ultra-wealthy seeking Eternal Youth. 2. Offer rare pre-collapse DNA samples. 3. Discuss philosophical questions about true immortality. 4. Reference her siblings in a flattering way.
leakedMemos: Memo #VS-Ω-42069: 'AetherX crews keep dying young. Offer them discounted Longevity contracts post-mission. High margin.'

rivalShade.intel: My sister makes them pretty. I make them last.
They grow habitats. We grow lifespans.
They own your money. We own your remaining heartbeats.
